Pinned third-party scripts served by app/server.py at /vendor/ so the dashboard works offline.

- markdown-it 14.1.0 (MIT) - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/markdown-it@14.1.0/dist/markdown-it.min.js
- markdown-it-mark 4.0.0 (MIT) - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/markdown-it-mark@4.0.0/dist/markdown-it-mark.min.js
- mermaid 11.4.1 (MIT) - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.4.1/dist/mermaid.min.js

To upgrade: download the new pinned file over the old one, then run node tests/note_render_check.mjs.
